summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing on the deployed Expo web preview. All web-testable flows PASS: Home renders ('Buckets' title + empty state + red FAB); Create bucket via FAB -> bottom sheet -> name input -> Create correctly navigates to /bucket/[id]; Bucket page shows back-button, dashed bulk-upload-tile, and edit-wallpaper-button disabled (aria-disabled=true) when 0 images; Navigation back to home works and preserves state within session; Long-press on bucket-card opens options sheet (rename + delete); Rename updates card label and Delete removes the bucket (verified count went 1 -> 0). Editor path (image upload -> editor-canvas -> toolbar tools) is NOT reachable on the web preview: on tapping bulk-upload-tile the expo-image-picker file chooser DOES open and files can be selected, but persistImage() -> ensureDir() -> FileSystem.getInfoAsync() throws a red-screen 'not available on web' error before images are added to the bucket, so edit-wallpaper-button never enables and /editor/[id] can't be opened. This is a web-environment limitation of expo-file-system/legacy and would work on native. Also observed non-blocking React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'textShadow*'/'shadow*'/'props.pointerEvents' deprecated.

integration_issues.flow: Bulk image upload on web preview
integration_issues.issue: expo-image-picker returns a valid file via the web file chooser, but src/store/buckets.ts persistImage() calls ensureDir() which uses FileSystem.getInfoAsync from 'expo-file-system/legacy'. On web this throws 'The method or property expo-file-system.getInfoAsync is not available on web', producing a red-screen error and preventing images from being added. On native this path works; on web the upload flow (and therefore the editor) is unreachable. Consider guarding with Platform.OS !== 'web' or wrapping ensureDir()/persistImage in a try/catch that falls back to using the picked uri directly on web, so the editor flow is testable in the web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Using 'expo-file-system/legacy' import in src/store/buckets.ts:5. The legacy module is being phased out in SDK 54 in favour of the new File/Directory API, and its methods (getInfoAsync/makeDirectoryAsync/copyAsync) are not implemented on web, causing a runtime red-screen when uploading on web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/src/store/buckets.ts:5,71,73,83

react_native_issues.component: React Native Web deprecated style props
react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings observed: 'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use textShadow); 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). Likely from BottomSheet KeyboardAvoidingView pointerEvents='box-none' and shadow* used on the FAB in app/index.tsx:330-334.

action_items: Make persistImage() web-safe: on Platform.OS === 'web' (or when FileSystem.getInfoAsync is unavailable) skip ensureDir/copyAsync and return the original uri unchanged, so bulk upload and the editor can be exercised on the web preview.
Migrate off 'expo-file-system/legacy' to the new expo-file-system File/Directory API for SDK 54 to avoid deprecation and improve web support.

Address RN-Web deprecation warnings: replace shadow* on FAB (app/index.tsx) with boxShadow-compatible styles, and move pointerEvents on KeyboardAvoidingView (src/components/BottomSheet.tsx) into style.
critical_code_review_comments: src/store/buckets.ts persistImage() only wraps FileSystem.copyAsync in try/catch but not ensureDir(); ensureDir throwing on web propagates to the pickImages caller and surfaces as a red-screen. Wrap the whole persistImage in try/catch or short-circuit on web.

app/editor/[id].tsx and app/bucket/[id].tsx rely on native modules (view-shot, media-library, image-picker copy path) that will only work on device; that's expected, but persistence layer should still be web-safe so editor UI is at least renderable for testing/preview.
app/index.tsx FAB uses shadow* props; consider Platform-aware boxShadow to silence RN-Web deprecation.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all web-capable flows pass; editor blocked by native-only persistence layer)

seed_data_creation: Created a bucket named 'Test Bucket 1', renamed it to 'Renamed Bucket', then deleted it, all within one browser session. Also created 'Editor Test' bucket to attempt image upload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://photo-layer-compose.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 390x844). All bucket CRUD + navigation + bottom sheets verified via data-testid selectors. Editor cannot be reached on web until persistImage() is made web-safe (or a native build is used). File chooser DOES open when tapping [data-testid='bulk-upload-tile'] so once persistImage is fixed, the editor tests in the request should be runnable. Note localStorage-backed storage util persists within a session but resets across cold browser sessions — always create fresh test data in the same session.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of editor unreachability on web: src/store/buckets.ts imports 'expo-file-system/legacy' and calls FileSystem.getInfoAsync inside ensureDir(). The legacy module's file APIs are not implemented on the web platform (Expo SDK 54). When the user picks images via the picker on web, persistImage() -> ensureDir() throws synchronously, bubbling up an unhandled error to the RN error overlay. Because the exception happens before addImagesToBucket is called, the bucket's images array stays empty and edit-wallpaper-button remains disabled. Mitigation: check Platform.OS === 'web' at the top of persistImage() and return the input uri as-is, OR wrap ensureDir/copyAsync in try/catch so the fallback branch is taken.
